messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] High error-rate alert for tenant "deimos" in eu-west-1 (Dedicated pool: delta-3). Elevated 5xx and token timeouts. Pager to oncall.
Arjun (oncall): ack. I'm on it — pulling kube logs & runtime traces. @Sara H can you grab recent rollout history for model groups serving deimos?
Sara H: looking now. There's a config drift: route for deimos was unintentionally set to `rw-large-3` yesterday during traffic shaping. Prior stable was `rw-stable-2`. Error spike correlates with increased sequence lengths from customer.
Mike R: runtime note: rw-large-3 shows KV-cache pressure on delta-3 GPUs, causing retry storms. We have a quick mitigation: pin tenant to safe variant `rw-stable-2-quant` (4bit) or route to replica pool `delta-4` if capacity exists.
Arjun (oncall): prefer pin to safe variant to avoid cross-pool moves. Can someone apply tenant-level override? I can handoff to Jen for the change.
Jen L: on it. Applying tenant override to pin model -> `rw-stable-2-quant` and set fallback policy to `failover-to-safe` for the next 30m. Will also disable burst routing to avoid thrash.
ops-bot: running command
```
POST /admin/tenants/deimos/overrides
{
  "model_pin": "rw-stable-2-quant",
  "fallback_policy": "failover-to-safe",
  "duration": "30m",
  "disable_burst": true
}
```
ops-bot: override applied (job id: 8a3f). Routing table updated; cache invalidation queued.
support-bot: FYI CS notified (Deimos contacts) and they've opened a support ticket. Customer impact estimated: 12% of requests failing, tail latency ~8s, region eu-west-1.
Arjun (oncall): monitoring now — can everyone watch these dashboards: token-errors, kv-cache-miss, per-tenant latency. If errors don't drop within 5 min we'll escalate to dedicated pool failover.
Sara H: after override, initial metrics look better — 5xx rate dropping from 12% -> 3% in 2min. KV-cache misses decreasing.
Mike R: leaving note — pin avoids the problematic kernels in rw-large-3. Plan: create a short-term canary on delta-4 later tonight once load stabilizes.
Arjun (oncall): thanks. Jen, handoff to you for incident lead while I finish paging rotation. Please keep logs of commands and timeline for postmortem.
Jen L: taking lead. I'll keep this thread updated. Tentative timeline: monitor 30m, if stable extend override to 3h then schedule planned model re-pin rollback at low-traffic window.
ops-bot: scheduled auto-rollback at +30m unless extended by owner.
support-bot: Customer has acknowledged mitigation and asked for incident summary.
Jen L: drafting incident note now, will include root cause (config drift -> model choice + KV pressure), mitigation (tenant pin + disabled burst), next steps (capacity plan, tighter config guards, automated preflight for model changes). Owning postmortem: Sara H + Mike R.
Arjun (oncall): handing off fully. Marking incident as "mitigated" for paging but still open for postmortem. I'll update oncall status.
Jen L: confirmed. Closing active pager. Will post postmortem draft in #postmortems once done. :white_check_mark:
